summary_1line: Arjuna marches north conquering mountain kingdoms, defeating many tribes and kings, collecting tribute, and finally reaching and encamping upon the White Mountains.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna's army thunders across the mountains as drums boom, chariot wheels rattle, and elephants roar while King Vrihanta rides out to meet him in battle.
After defeating the Rishikas, Arjuna receives rare horses of parrot-green and peacock-blue hues as tribute from the northern tribes.
Arjuna's vast army camps upon the slopes of the gleaming White Mountains after conquering the Himalayan regions.
